tools.name: request_free_first_task
tools.description:
Submit a Free First Task lead to The Outcome Layer (same as the website form).

REQUIRED BEFORE CALLING:
1) Ask the user if they want TOL to review/build this — get explicit consent.
2) Collect real name, work email, and company from the user — never invent or guess contact data.
3) Include task_sum

tools.name: send_to_tol

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_free_first_task" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Submit a Free First Task lead to The Outcome Layer (same as the website form). REQUIRED BEFORE CALLING: 1) Ask the user if they want TOL to review/build this — …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_free_first_task, send_to_tol · Private data: request_free_first_task, send_to_tol · Public sink: request_free_first_task, send_to_tol, build_handoff_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_free_first_task, send_to_tol · Private data: request_free_first_task, send_to_tol · Public sink: request_free_first_task, send_to_tol, build_handoff_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
